Agents spawned without a name no longer show up as `general-purpose`.

- 0.65.6 fell back to the agent type when an agent had no name, so agents launched without `name` all read `general-purpose` again. Like the footer list, rows that already show the description (`/desk-activity` agent rows, background task cards, the "Waiting for … agents" rows) now show only the description, and the progress band and activity lanes use the description as the label. Named agents keep their name; shells and monitors keep their kind

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
